title: UPSSSC Auditor / Assistant Accountant Online Form 2026 (1937 Posts)
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
vacancyDetails: 1937 posts of Auditor / Assistant Accountant under UPSSSC recruitment
qualification: Bachelor degree in Commerce / related stream or as specified in UPSSSC advertisement
ageLimit: As per UPSSSC rules for the advertisement
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsssc.gov.in
2. Complete OTR if required
3. Open Auditor / Assistant Accountant apply link
4. Fill form, upload documents, pay fee
5. Submit and print application
shortDescription: UPSSSC Auditor / Assistant Accountant Online Form 2026 for 1937 posts. Apply at upsssc.gov.in.
content:
UPSSSC has invited online applications for Auditor / Assistant Accountant recruitment totaling about 1,937 posts.

Commerce graduates meeting age and other eligibility criteria can apply through upsssc.gov.in. Selection is based on written examination followed by document verification.
